fusions.name: Hushing Bramble
fusions.desc: Brambles close over the mouth of one enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 10 damage and taking its next action away for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Ogham Stave
fusions.desc: A strike with a stave cut with tree-letters that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and has a 30% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Leafbound Recital
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 30% for 15 seconds. You restore 8 health.

fusions.name: Pressed Verse
fusions.desc: Each time your mana becomes full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 20 seconds.
